I'm a master's student at the [Bren School of Environmental Science & Management](https://bren.ucsb.edu) at UC Santa Barbara, specializing in Water Resource Management. My work sits at the intersection of **spatial data science**, **climate-smart agriculture**, and **conservation planning** — with a particular focus on using satellite remote sensing and geospatial modeling to understand how land and water systems are changing. Before Bren, I worked in sustainability communications in New York and spent time farming, volunteering on kiwi conservation in New Zealand, and getting my hands dirty in as many ecosystems as possible. --- ```{=html}
Education
Research
Conservation & Field
Other Experience
Jun 2021
BBA — Finance & Urban Land Economics
University of Wisconsin, Madison

Graduated with a 3.67 GPA. Undergraduate research on applying Low Income Housing Tax Credits to the Bay Area housing crisis.

2021 – 2023
Environmental & Social Impact Partnerships
The Vita Coco Company — New York City, NY

Led ESG strategy and sustainability partnerships. Coordinated the brand's first social impact campaign, driving $13,000 in nonprofit donations and 10% social following growth.

Sep – Oct 2023
Farmer
Worldwide Organization of Organic Farmers — Bogotá, Colombia

Worked on organic farms through the WWOOF program, gaining hands-on experience in sustainable agriculture.

Jan – Jul 2024
Plant Specialist
Broadway Terrace Nursery — Oakland, CA

Developed deep knowledge of native California plant communities while advising customers on restoration and garden ecology.

Aug – Sep 2024
Kiwi Conservation Volunteer
Whakatāne Kiwi Trust — Whakatāne, New Zealand

Maintained pest control trap networks and tracked kiwi chick locations via radio transmitter to build geospatial population maps.

Sep 2024
Master of Environmental Science & Management (MESM)
Bren School — UC Santa Barbara

Specialization in Water Resource Management. Focus in Environmental Communication. 4.00 GPA. Mentor in the Bren-ES Fellows program and Graduate Mentor with The Wildlife Society.

Nov 2024 – Present
Graduate Research Assistant
UCSB Water, Vegetation & Society Lab

Developed a novel satellite image labeling protocol to build a benchmark ML dataset mapping dry-season irrigation across Zambia. Managed a team of 4 undergraduate researchers across 2,325 labeled images.

Dec 2024 – Jun 2025
Conservation Intern
Los Padres ForestWatch — Santa Barbara, CA

Conducted GIS habitat analyses evaluating ecological impacts of proposed Forest Service fuel reduction projects. Assessed Adenostoma sparsifolium (Redshanks) distribution for climate adaptation planning.

Apr 2025 – Present
Data Manager — Master's Group Project
Conservation International (IPLC Center)

Using ArcGIS Pro and R to assess climate risks intersecting with Indigenous Peoples & Local Communities territories across Amazonia, identifying lands suitable for Nature-based Solutions intervention.

Jun – Aug 2025
Climate-Smart Agriculture Research Intern
University of Zambia — Lusaka, Zambia

Revealed 400 km² of previously undocumented small-scale dry-season irrigation through geospatial analysis. Built a Shiny app to make findings accessible to local stakeholders and policymakers.

Aug 2025 – Present
Independent Researcher — Remote Sensing of Irrigation & Drought
UCSB Geography — Advisor: Zoe Pierrat

Isolating the human contribution to evapotranspiration using OpenET and NLDAS model data across Midwestern croplands to estimate consumptive water use and aquifer drawdown during drought events.

Oct 2025 – Present
Arnhold Graduate Fellow
Conservation International + Ashley Larsen Lab, UCSB

Developing a spatial multi-criteria decision analysis for agrivoltaic and agroforestry suitability across Sub-Saharan Africa, integrating 10+ climate, soil, land cover, and socioeconomic criteria.

Expected Jun 2026
MESM — Graduation
Bren School — UC Santa Barbara
```
